description.value: Nemesis Coffee is a Vancouver-based specialty coffee roaster with five Lower Mainland café locations; the GNW branch sits at 555 Great Northern Way in the arts-and-innovation corridor between Mount Pleasant and East Vancouver. The café serves espresso and everyday filter coffees sourced from named farms alongside freshly baked pastries from their in-house Dope Bakehouse. The brand actively supports World Coffee Research and acknowledges operating on the unceded territories of the Musqueam, Squamish, and Tsleil-Waututh Nations.
